prompts.prompt: Create ONE coherent, complete, empty 3D-game battlefield reference image for Warwrit's OLD RUINED WATERMILL. Use the first attached image for the mill's identity, ruined construction, restrained slate/soot/umber palette and matte painterly materials. Use the second attached image ONLY for the spatial idea of a broad courtyard, a raised bank on the right with stairs, and a river on the left. Remove all people, creatures, interface, grids and text. This entire image will be sent as ONE input to image-to-3D, so all terrain, architecture and props must form a connected, spatially unambiguous scene with one shared perspective and one shared painterly material language. Camera: elevated 35-degree three-quarter overview, weak perspective/long lens, see the whole courtyard and whole mill clearly. Layout: a substantial burned stone watermill with collapsed shingled roof and soot-black charred broken rafters stands at the UPPER LEFT of the connected terrain patch. Its stationary wooden waterwheel is broken and missing part of the rim, beside the cold shallow brook along the LEFT boundary. The brook includes irregular slate rocks and painted pale current seams; a narrow weathered timber footbridge crosses it at lower left. The CENTRAL and FRONT two-thirds are an open broad, mostly level packed-earth courtyard for tactical movement, with a few old embedded flagstones and shallow puddles. Keep this area readable, calm and wide rather than cluttered. On the RIGHT is a low raised rocky terrace about one metre high, clearly joined to the yard by broad worn stone steps. A closed wooden cellar hatch lies in front of the mill clear of its masonry. Only a few low collapsed stone-wall segments provide cover near the edges. Sparse dry ochre grass, a short broken wooden fence and two modest twisted leafless shrubs at the perimeter. No floating disconnected props. No active fire, smoke, magic, emblems or newly invented narrative events. Serious grounded medieval scale: terrain about 25 by 22 metres, mill about 8 metres wide and 6 metres tall, doors adult human-sized. Strong realistic construction and interesting ruin silhouette; NOT a toy, cute miniature, chunky cube kit or glossy CGI. Rendering: cohesive painterly 3D asset concept, broad matte graphic-novel color washes, irregular selective dark major contours, restrained detail on the building and quiet broad soil planes. Every component must appear made by the same artist; avoid photographic noisy ground or primitive untextured objects. Soft neutral overcast light with readable dark openings and gentle contact shadows, no dramatic cast shadows. Keep the ENTIRE connected terrain patch in frame with comfortable transparent margins, naturally ragged shallow earthen boundary, no square plinth, no thick pedestal, no distant landscape, no sky, no opaque backdrop. Genuine transparent background outside the terrain, opaque water and ground inside. One image, not panels or a sheet. Request 1536x1536.
